description: Human-readable join contract for resume section objects. Each section is a separate locked file related by ID. fill_resume.py gathers these objects, validates foreign keys, and fills locked-resume-template.docx by discovering {{TOKENS}} and resolving them by naming convention (ADR-021, ADR-049, ADR-052). After filling, it prints an advisory last-page fill estimate via page_fill.py (ADR-051). This file is documentation, not a nested resume instance.

excluded_from_fill.notes: Job-search puller filters only. fill_resume.py must not read this file. target_focus and summary are not stored here.

identity_rules.notes: Contact is the parent object. Child sections are related only through foreign keys on contact. Do not embed child objects inside contact. Do not put contact_id on child files.

abort_rules: Abort if any required section object or required field is missing.
Abort if contact.education_id does not equal education.id.
Abort if contact.skills_id does not equal skills.id.
Abort if contact.job_history_id does not equal job_history.id.
Abort if contact.professional_summary_id does not equal professional_summary.id.
Abort if contact.projects_id does not equal projects.id.
Abort if any projects digit-key entry has only one of title or summary populated.
Abort unless tailored-resume.md role headers are the consecutive master-template prefix 1..N with N in 5-10. No skipping, reordering, or arbitrary title matching.
Abort if locked keys 11-12 appear on the resume.
Abort if tailored-resume.md bullet count per included role is outside 1-5.
Abort if any printed bullet is missing a non-empty theme before the first colon.
Abort if a template token names an unknown object or field.
Never write to .ai/guardrails/ during a normal resume-tailor run.

token_grammar.notes: fill_resume.py discovers {{TOKENS}} in locked-resume-template.docx. It does not keep a hardcoded field map. Uppercase token bodies casefold, then split on underscore. Longest join-contract object prefix wins so PROFESSIONAL_SUMMARY_SUMMARY binds to professional_summary.summary.
token_grammar.locked_indexed: {{OBJECT_INDEX_FIELD}} on job_history uses the digit key ({{JOB_HISTORY_5_TITLE}} -> job_history["5"].title), not the fifth tailored ## block.
token_grammar.projects_alias: {{PROJECTS_N_TITLE}} binds to projects["N"].title. {{PROJECTS_N_SUMMERY}} is an intentional spelling alias of projects["N"].summary (ADR-052). The locked Word template exposes only N=1. Later digit keys are analysis-only until a future layout change. Do not put a Projects section in tailored-resume.md.
token_grammar.projects_omission: When projects["1"].title and projects["1"].summary are both null or blank, fill_resume.py removes the static Projects heading and both project-1 paragraphs. {{PROJECTS_N_URL}} binds to projects["N"].url. Partial data on any digit key aborts. Empty paragraphs are not enough: the heading has no token and must be removed with the block.
token_grammar.overlay_skills: {{SKILL_NN}} is the ranked list from sandbox tailored-resume.md, not locked-skills.json.
token_grammar.overlay_bullets: {{JOB_HISTORY_N_BN}} is the Nth consecutive printed role (master prefix 1..N). Not role accomplishments. Word bolds the theme through the first colon (colon included).
token_grammar.unknown_token: Unknown object or field aborts. No aliases for {{ROLE_*}}, {{EDU_*}}, {{SUMMARY}}, or {{CONTACT_LINK_URL}}.
token_grammar.missing_optional: Missing optional slots (no links[1], no SKILL_40, unused B4/B5, unused printed keys N+1..10) fill as empty string. Empty paragraphs are removed. Keys 11-12 are never printed.
token_grammar.printed_prefix: Default N=5. Deepen to the smallest N in 6..10 only when older locked evidence closes a JD required or preferred gap. Existing five-role sandboxes remain valid.

page_fill_estimate.notes: Advisory only. After writing the docx, fill_resume.py prints a last-page fill line (e.g. 'last page ~42% full across 3 page(s) (target >=75% usable)'). Deterministic and approximate: reads section page_height minus top/bottom margins as usable height, estimates wrapped-line height per paragraph from the body table row/cell widths (regular-weight twip map for body bullets, bold map for headers), and returns (page_count, last_page_fill_ratio). Never edits the docx and never fails the fill or CI.
page_fill_estimate.contract: Target 75% of usable last-page height; the resume-tailor SKILL re-evaluates only when N>5 and the estimate is below ~65% (tolerance band). Remedy is gap-only: add locked JD-gap-closing evidence (bullet on a printed role, then next master role) until >=~75% or evidence is exhausted, then ship and log.

field_notes.postal_code: ZIP used in the Word header as city, ST ZIP.
field_notes.links: Array of {platform, url}. May be empty. {{CONTACT_LINKS_1_URL}} is contact.links[0].url (1-based). Missing indexes fill as empty string.
field_notes.education_id: FK to education.id. Do not nest the education object.
field_notes.skills_id: FK to skills.id. Do not nest the skills object.
field_notes.job_history_id: FK to job_history.id. Do not nest roles.
field_notes.professional_summary_id: FK to professional_summary.id. Do not nest summary text.
field_notes.projects_id: FK to projects.id. Do not nest the projects object. Projects has no contact_id.

field_notes.id: Skills identity key (e.g. skl_001). Flattened; no numeric wrapper key.
field_notes.selected_skills: Preferred skill vocabulary for resume-tailor ranking.
field_notes.all_skills: Full locked skill vocabulary. Use only when a JD skill is absent from selected_skills.
field_notes.dropped_fields: target_focus and summary moved to professional_summary (ADR-019).

field_notes.target_focus: Positioning headline. Stored on this object; not rendered in locked-resume-template.docx.
field_notes.notes: Strings are copied exactly from the former locked-profile.json. fill_resume.py reads this file; {{PROFESSIONAL_SUMMARY_SUMMARY}} binds to summary. {{PROFESSIONAL_SUMMARY_TARGET_FOCUS}} would bind if added to the template.

projects.entry_key_rule: Digit-only keys ("1", "2", ...) are projects. Ignore id when iterating entries. Do not convert numeric keys into a JSON array.

field_notes.id: Envelope identity key (e.g. prj_001) as a sibling of numeric project keys.
field_notes.title: Project title. Null together with summary at deploy. Do not invent.
field_notes.url: Project URL. JSON field is url. Word placeholder {{PROJECTS_1_URL}} is the intentional alias.
field_notes.summary: Project summary. JSON field is summary. Word placeholder {{PROJECTS_1_SUMMERY}} is the intentional alias.
field_notes.paired_fields: Each digit-key entry must populate both title and summary or neither (both null). Partial data aborts fill.
field_notes.printed_slot: locked-resume-template.docx prints only key "1" between Education and Skills. Later keys are valid evidence for job analysis (capability/technology only; never employment tenure).
field_notes.section_removal: When key "1" is unpopulated, the Projects heading and both project-1 paragraphs are removed entirely.

job_history.role_key_rule: Digit-only keys ("1"..."12") are roles. Ignore id when iterating positions. Do not convert numeric role keys into a JSON array.

field_notes.id: Envelope identity key (e.g. jh_001) as a sibling of numeric role keys.
field_notes.title: Locked position title. Do not invent or rename.
field_notes.start_date: Role start as M/YYYY or MM/YYYY as stored.
field_notes.end_date: Role end as M/YYYY, MM/YYYY, or Present as stored.

layout.notes: Layout only. Ten Word slots (JOB_HISTORY_1..JOB_HISTORY_10). Right column order is Education, optional Projects, then Skills (ADR-052). Placeholders bind to data-model fields by naming convention (ADR-021). Per-job bullets and skill ranking come from sandbox tailored-resume.md. Printed output is the consecutive prefix 1..N (ADR-049).
